run_train_main: run the train.main function with a config to train a transformer grammar model
build_train_input: build a training input iterator with shuffling and multithreaded preprocessing
build_eval_input: build an evaluation input iterator without shuffling for single-pass evaluation
build_evaluator: build an evaluator function that computes loss over the evaluation dataset
save_checkpoint: save a training checkpoint with params, opt_state, and config to a pickle file
